_comment: DUNGEON RUN enemy data. Enemies target the summon with the HIGHEST current HP if any summon is alive, otherwise the player. Exception: ignoresSummons: true or targetPriority overrides. Intent is always telegraphed, including target.

enemies.name: Cave Bat
enemies._note: Flies over the summons. Punishes a player who thinks a wall of bodies solves everything.

enemies.name: Blood Blob
enemies._note: THE SWARM. Splits on death into two Blood Motes. Punishes single-target-only decks. Split depth is capped at 1 so the fight cannot run forever.

enemies.name: Goblin Shaman
enemies._note: THE HEALER. Heals every other goblin 6 per turn. Kill it first or nothing you do sticks. Low HP on purpose - this is a targeting puzzle, not a damage check.

enemies.name: Goblin Shieldbearer
enemies._note: Gives block to its allies, not itself. Makes the Shaman hard to reach.

enemies.name: Goblin Brute
enemies._note: The clock. Ignore it and it ends you. Kill it and the Shaman undoes your work.

enemies.name: The Leech
enemies._note: THE SUMMON-EATER. A sandworm thing that erupts from the floor. Devours summons and heals itself for their full remaining HP. This teaches the Corrupted Crab fight before the player ever reaches it.

intents.text: Submerges. Takes no damage this turn.

enemies.name: Powder Wretch
enemies._note: THE GLASS CANNON. 8 HP, hits for 22. Kill it on turn one or take a wound you carry for the rest of the run. Ignores summons - you cannot hide behind a wall.

intents.text: Winding up. Attacks for 22 next turn.

enemies.name: Iron Torturer
enemies._note: ELITE 1. Gains Strength every other turn. The longer the fight runs, the worse it gets.

enemies.name: THE QUESTIONER
enemies._note: ELITE 2. The curse-giver. Deliberately placed at elite tier, not basic - a curse-giver in an early fight would end runs before the player has a deck that can race it. Its tricks are the INVERSE of the crab's: the crab punishes small hits, the Questioner punishes slow play and hoarded energy.

passives.name: Extract Confession
passives.text: At the end of each of its turns, shuffles a Doubt curse into your draw pile, but never more than 1 in your deck at a time. Curses you collect here STAY in your deck after the fight.
passives._maxInDeckComment: How many of its curses can be in your deck at once. While that many are there, it adds no more.

passives.name: Iron Maiden
passives.text: If you end your turn with unspent energy, take 10 damage.

enemies._comment: Enemies from here to the Dungeon Hound were added by Claude at the producer's request (more enemies, a third elite). Ben: tune or replace.
enemies.name: Cellar Spider
Hooded Acolyte
enemies._note: Marks you, so everything hits you harder, then patches up its friends.

enemies.name: THE KENNEL MASTER
enemies._note: ELITE 3. Lets his hounds off the chain. Kill him and the hounds go with him.

enemies.name: CORRUPTED CRAB
enemies._fightEndsComment: true: when this one dies, the fight is over. Its minions fall with it.
enemies._requiresComment: An intent with requires: armorBroken only happens once Encrusted Armor is gone; until then it does its fallback instead.
enemies._note: Designed by Ben. Encrusted Armor counts HITS, not damage - deliberate, so one big Golden Light cannot erase the mechanic.

passives.name: Encrusted Armor
passives.text: Takes half damage from the first 5 hits of the fight. Then the barnacles fall off and the armor breaks permanently.

timedAbilities.name: Corrupting Beam
timedAbilities.text: The shard fires. Steals one of your summons PERMANENTLY: it fights for the crab now. If you have no summons, hits you for 18.

fallback.label: Barnacles cling
fallback.text: The barnacles cling to its shell. Nothing comes loose.

fallback.label: Barnacles cling
fallback.text: The barnacles cling to its shell. Nothing comes loose.
